evidence.claim: Customer C07297 reported unrecognized $482.12 purchase on card C07297-K1, transaction 3476682.
Transaction 3476682 was online from a device marked New for this account (Trident/7.0|Windows 7|ie 11.0 for desktop|1920x1080).
Burst of 4 online product C transactions occurred within 30 minutes on 2016-11-21: 3476602 ($478.95), 3476633 ($456.96), 3476665 ($488.04), 3476682 ($482.12).
The new device profile is shared by 4 cards across different customers including C09933-K2, C07987-K2, C02354-K2.
Card C07297-K1 has 6 connected cards via shared devices.
Three similar closed cases (CC-4717, CC-1990, CC-1792) all resolved as confirmed_fraud with pattern card_not_present_new_device and similar exposure.
Card-not-present fraud from a new device is stronger than plain CNP but not definitive proof without customer verification.

case.summary: Customer C07297 reported unauthorized transaction 3476682 ($482.12). Investigation reveals a burst of 4 high-value online transactions within 30 minutes from a new device. The device is shared with multiple unrelated customers, indicating potential coordinated fraud. Similar historical cases were confirmed fraud. Fraud probability assessed at 0.75 based on strong signals, pending customer verification.
